selection_checklist: Verify device class (comparator) and output stage (open-collector) — never substitute an uncompensated open-collector comparator for a push-pull op-amp without circuit redesign.
Confirm supply rail span (2–30 V rec, 36 V abs max) and exact SOIC-8 pinout (1=OUT_A, 2=IN_NEG_A, 3=IN_POS_A, 4=VEE, 5=IN_POS_B, 6=IN_NEG_B, 7=OUT_B, 8=VCC).
Verify input common-mode headroom (Non-RR-In), output swing (Non-RR-Out), and Vos (5 mV max) against signal chain budget.
Check closed-loop bandwidth (GBWP / Acl), full-power slew rate (SR / 2π·Vpeak), and capacitive-load phase margin on the bench.
